subject: Next steps: procurement route assessment / PO vs card / marketplace
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + procurement routing questions

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can thread this into procurement.

Highlights from the call:
- Use case: internal knowledge retrieval + anonymized analytics (low PII exposure)
- Expected monthly spend: mid range (~$6k–$12k) with growth triggers in Q4
- SLA needs: sub-200ms 95th for customer-facing endpoints

Procurement questions to help us advise on the fastest commercial path:
1) Preferred payment method: does VeridianBio require a PO/invoice for all vendor spend, or can card payments be used for lower-value pilots? Any dollar threshold?
2) Vendor onboarding: do you require vendor portal registration, W-9, bank ACH info, or a separate vendor packet?
3) Marketplace interest: would a marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Redwood marketplace) be acceptable to accelerate procurement?
4) Approval timeline: typical AP/Procurement lead time for a new vendor (PO issuance)

Next steps from our side: we can send W-9 + SOC2 summary and a short PO-friendly SOW for signature. If card is acceptable for the pilot, we can get started immediately while vendor onboarding is proceeding.

Thanks — if you prefer, we can loop in your procurement contact directly.

Best,
Jonas

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement routing questions

Hi Jonas — great to meet earlier. Quick answers below and copying our procurement mailbox for any paperwork.

- Payment method: VeridianBio prefers PO/invoice for all vendor engagements greater than $2,500. For one-off purchases or pilots under $2.5k, corporate card is allowed, but we try to keep card use limited.
- Vendor onboarding: yes — vendor portal registration is required. Standard docs: W-9, bank ACH form, vendor contact, and completed security questionnaire for any data access.
- Marketplace: Marketplace listings are often preferred by our Procurement team because they simplify invoicing and purchasing. If you are on AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace, that can expedite approval.
- Typical timeline: vendor onboarding + PO issuance is usually 2–4 weeks after complete docs; expedited requests occasionally happen but require finance sign-off.

Procurement contact is procurement@veridianbio.com — I suggest sending the W-9 and SOC2 summary to them and they will send a vendor portal invite if everything looks good.

Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, VeridianBio
elaine.park@veridianbio.com

Summary of procurement constraints from VeridianBio:
- PO required for > $2,500
- Vendor portal + W-9 + ACH + security questionnaire required
- Marketplace preferred and can speed up approvals

Action items (internal):
- Jonas: send W-9 + SOC2 summary to procurement@veridianbio.com and attach a PO-friendly SOW (I can draft the SOW template).
- Karthik: please prepare an itemized pricing/usage estimate that breaks out the pilot month and 3-month ramp so procurement can see expected invoice amounts (helps if they require budget owner sign-off).

Risk note: if Veridian chooses PO route, the 2–4 week timeline may delay the pilot. If the pilot needs to start immediately, card for initial month (if under $2.5k) plus concurrent vendor onboarding is the pragmatic path.
